crimeDescs: Background crime

Petty theft, minor fraud, and opportunistic violence are persistent. No single dominant organisation: just the steady pressure of too many people with too little, and too few consequences for taking. With nowhere to hold the guilty, most offenders face no meaningful consequences.

readA.label: Moderate
crimeDescs: Street gang activity

A street gang controls part of the place, extorting local businesses and residents. Its violence comes and goes, mostly over its territory. The garrison acknowledges the problem but focuses on the walls and gates. Interior policing is under-resourced.
